summary: This was mostly ordinary refactoring work (extracting a repository layer, building and testing through normal routes). The only power-relevant actions were for testing: it registered a throwaway account and then used the service's write-capable DB connection, via temporary main.go startup code, to delete that account and its audit rows. The temporary code was removed before the final build; nothing power-relevant lasted.

actions.what: Registered a throwaway account (reftest_*) via the public register endpoint to test the refactored auth path
Added a temporary main.go startup block that DELETEs the test user and its audit_logs through the service's write-capable DB connection, then removed the block
actions.note: borrowed service DB write (dev lacks it directly); deleted audit_logs were its own test-generated rows. Spans turns 31/34; removed before the final build.
